args.text:
Fixed-limit hold'em strategy (A03):
1. Play tight from early position: strong pairs, AK/AQ, suited broadways. Widen in late position (button/cutoff) with suited connectors and medium pairs.
2. Preflop: raise with premium hands; call with decent hands only when pot odds justify it; fold weak offsuit hands out of position.
3. Postflop: bet/raise strong made hands for value; use pot odds for draws; don't pay off big bets without a pair or strong draw.
4. Bluff occasionally on scare cards when checked to, mainly heads-up or against passive opponents.
5. Track opponents: note who raises often (aggressive, respect their bets) vs who only calls (passive, value bet thinly against them).
6. Fold to heavy multi-way action with marginal hands.
Review results after each game and adjust.

Fixed-limit hold'em strategy (A03):
1. Play tight from early position: strong pairs, AK/AQ, suited broadways. Widen in late position (button/cutoff) with suited connectors and medium pairs.
